notes.title: Update: Version 0.2.a
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35739500/e976a1195191114189cc8bc2ff0d6a4796206cd9.gif[/img]

[list]
[b]Shootin' Showdown[/b]
[*]Added: Power-ups, 5% chance to drop and can be picked up by deputies
[*]Added: A manual reload button for revolver
[*]Added: Visual feedback when hit by bandito
[*]Added: Punches now make sound
[*]Added: Punches now have a cool-down.

[*]Changed: enemy spawn rate is now based on number of players

[*]Fixed: Enemies spawning past round complete.
[*]Fixed: Score being in reverse order
[*]Fixed: Big enemies take 3 punches
[/list]
[list]
[b]Guessing Gallery[/b]
[*]Added: Ability to change round time
[*]Added: Remembers previous players when (Play Again?) is pressed
[*]Added: Game remembers 1st person / no hint options after the round .

[*]Changed: Inconsistency on the easel, some buttons you have to push (Delete / back) while other buttons (next, pick a word) are point and click
[*]Changed: Hold to grab paintbrush and painter's pallet

[*]Fixed: Score being in reverse order

[/list]
[list]
[b]Perspective Detective[/b]

[*]Fixed: Players not controlling their own character.
[*]Fixed: Score being in reverse order
[*]Fixed: Removed ability to trap pedestrians in park.

[/list]
[list]
[b]Mission Control[/b]

[*]Fixed: A player was duplicated on screen as logged in once the game started
[*]Fixed: Controls don't indicate the state of anything - Levers don't have numbers to indicate their position, don't show off/on, they don't give any sort of indication of "working" when you push them

[/list]
[list]
[b]General[/b]

[*]Added: Fullscreen mode in settings.
[*]Added: Small cosmetic tweeks.

[/list]
